purpose: Whole-body vascular art study; not runtime replacement

v1.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: full-body overview art for a friendly 2D cell RTS game, FIRST integrated vascular-revision art study.

INPUTS:
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative appearance/layout: the current 1024 x 1536 full-body anatomy illustration.
Image 2 is a SUPPORTING CONNECTION PLAN, not a style reference. Use its circulation relationships, not its dashed lines, leader lines, lettering, white halos, junction dots or diagram layout.

OUTPUT: one complete portrait image, 1024 x 1536, same camera, body silhouette, pose, margins and organ positions as Image 1, plain white background. No labels, text, numbers, arrows, legend or extra panels. This must look like a polished revision of Image 1 itself, not a new character and not a flowchart.

CHANGE ONLY THE VASCULAR PRESENTATION AND THE MINIMAL UNDERLYING PATCHES NEEDED FOR IT:
Make the visible principal vessels coherent, readable and naturally integrated into the existing flat softly shaded cartoon anatomy. Smooth organic curves of consistent thickness, moderate red arterial and blue venous colours, muted violet for the small portal venous connection near the liver. No glowing effects, no dense microvascular web, no veins pasted indiscriminately over organ faces. Deeper trunk vessels disappear behind organs and emerge at appropriate ports. Keep the organ faces broad and quiet for game readability.

CONNECTION REQUIREMENTS:
- Separate neck-root branches for head and arms; head supply must not detour through shoulder joints. Brachiocephalic grouping on the person's right (image left), independent left carotid and left subclavian on image right.
- Distinct arterial supply and venous return through each arm and leg. At both elbows and ankles, crossings have clear occlusion and must not look like red-to-blue junctions. On the image-left lower leg the blue return remains separate from the red artery.
- Aortic root above the heart supplies both the main aorta and restrained coronary surface branches. Keep the descending trunk behind the heart and abdominal organs, near the current central trunk position.
- Suggest short blue pulmonary supply and red pulmonary return at the medial lung roots, partly hidden by the heart. The EXISTING blue branching bronchial tree inside each lung is an AIRWAY, not the venous network: preserve its branching shape, make it slightly muted blue-grey so it is visually separate, never connect its tips to blood vessels.
- Abdominal arterial branches supply liver, stomach, pancreas, both kidneys, intestines and pelvic organs. Use a small number of important branches and organ-edge entries, not an exposed wire network.
- Stomach, pancreas and intestinal venous return converge through the portal system into the liver; liver then returns to the caval trunk. Show this mainly as short visible edge portions with most deep route hidden. Do not draw a large purple loop over the stomach lumen.
- Kidney supply/return enter through their medial notches; keep distinct red and blue short stems. Do not enter randomly through their upper/lower lobes.
- Preserve the recognizable orange/peach stomach and its original upper inlet and lower curved digestive outlet. Food tract is not a red or blue vessel. Preserve the duodenal sweep and the original intestinal loops.
- Preserve all bone and joint shapes. Vessels pass around or behind them, not through white bone centres.

LAYOUT INVARIANTS:
Keep the head and brain, all organ silhouettes, heart at the original central chest location, lungs, liver on image-left, stomach on image-right, pancreas, kidneys, intestinal loops and bladder in EXACTLY their original positions and approximate extents.
Keep the original arms, hands, fingers, legs, feet and toes, body outline, soft highlights, colour balance and illustration character. Do not enlarge the torso or shorten the legs.
Reference coordinate landmarks: head centred near (510,90); shoulders (357,312) and (661,312); heart near (516,415); liver near (461,519); stomach near (554,519); kidney notches near (435,615),(586,615); bladder near (508,768); knees near (419,1000),(596,1000); ankles near (402,1318),(609,1318). These are registration hints, never printed.

Avoid photorealism, gore, horror, wet shiny organs, Cthulhu texture, additional organs, busy folds, lighting change, composition change, checkerboard background, and all schematic annotations. Prioritize preservation of Image 1 over inventing detail.
